weekly_mini_goals: Drinks only on one planned night (Friday)
targets.weigh_ins: Daily morning weigh-in, reported to Harper; judged on weekly average

meals.name: Protein Shake
steps: Add milk first, then remaining ingredients to blender.
Blend 45-60 sec until smooth.

meals.name: Eggs + Salsa
steps: Whisk eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Spray nonstick pan, medium-low heat; scramble 3-4 min until just set.
Top with salsa; fruit on the side.

meals.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
steps: Pre-packed Sunday: chicken + rice in container.
Add veg, onion, pepperoncini (veg Mon-Wed chopped Sunday, Thu-Fri chopped Wed night).
Dress with vinegar, oil, oregano, salt, pepper. Eat cold.

meals.name: Banana + Beef Jerky
steps: Zero prep; keep in desk drawer.

meals.name: Crockpot Beef Stew
ingredients: 2.5 lb top round or eye of round, 1.5 in chunks
1 bag (12 oz) frozen cut green beans
steps: Add beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic to crockpot.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, broth and all seasonings; stir; cover.
Cook LOW 8 hr or HIGH 4-5 hr.
Last 30 min: stir in green beans, then cornstarch slurry.
Remove bay leaves, stir in vinegar, split into 5 containers. Reheat 2-3 min. No celery.

meals.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken + Steamer Veg
ingredients: Per serving: 1 steamer veggie bag (or 1/2 large bag), 1/2 cup cooked rice
steps: Heat oven to 425F.
Toss chicken with oil, seasonings and lemon on lined sheet pan.
Bake 20-22 min to 165F.
Microwave steamer bag while it bakes.
Plate half with 1/2 cup rice and veg; pack the other half for Tuesday.

meals.name: Shrimp Rice Bowl
steps: Thaw shrimp in a bowl of cold water ~5 min; drain and pat dry.
Toss with Old Bay and lemon.
Eat cold or warm in pan 2 min.
Serve over rice with microwaved steamer veg.

meals.name: Date-Night Sirloin with Chimichurri (lemon-free, serves 2)
ingredients: Steaks: 2 top sirloin steaks (8 oz each); per steak 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1/4 tsp garlic powder; 1 tsp oil for pan
Potatoes: 600 g Yukon gold (300 g each), chunked; 1 tsp oil, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt
Asparagus: 1 bunch, woody ends snapped; salt and pepper

Greek salad: 2 romaine hearts chopped, 1 cucumber, 1 cup grape tomatoes, 1/4 cup pickled red onion, 4-5 kalamata olives, 3-4 pepperoncini; dressing 1.5 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, pinch salt and pepper
Chimichurri: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/4 cup chopped parsley, 1 minced garlic clove, 1/2 tsp oregano, pinch red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp salt
steps: Pat steaks dry and season; rest at room temp 20 min.
Mix chimichurri; set aside.
Air fry potatoes 400F 15-18 min, shake halfway.
Heat cast iron with 1 tsp oil until smoking; sear steaks 3-4 min per side to 130F (medium-rare); rest 5 min.
Same pan: asparagus with salt and pepper 4-5 min.
Toss salad with dressing.
Slice steak, spoon chimichurri over. Pair with 2 mocktails (or one light planned drink).

shopping_list.store: WinCo Foods, Springfield (in-store only, no online ordering)

Produce: Yukon gold potatoes - 1 bag (5 lb; need ~3.8 lb incl. Fri)
Berries or oranges - 1 clamshell berries or 2 oranges (Tue/Thu breakfast)
Meat: Top round or eye of round roast - 1 package (~2.5 lb; not pre-cut stew meat)
Frozen: Steamer veggie bags - 4 (mix broccoli, green beans, California blend)
Canned & Jarred: Red wine vinegar - 1 bottle, if low
Snacks: Beef jerky - 5 oz total (1 large bag or 5 x 1 oz bags; bulk bins work)
Mocktail add-ons: Lapsang souchong or smoked black tea - 1 box
Black tea bags - 1 box, if out
Unsweetened tart cherry juice - 1 small bottle

on_hand: Frozen chicken breast (thaw 3 lb: 2 lb Sunday lunches, 1 lb Monday sheet pan)

steps: 1. Start crockpot stew first (morning): cut beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic; add tomatoes, paste, broth, seasonings; LOW 8 hr. Last 30 min add green beans + slurry; finish with vinegar; portion into 5 containers.
2. Rice cooker: 2 cups dry rice (~6 cups cooked). 3/4 cup per lunch x5; rest for dinners (1/2 cup each).

3. Lunch chicken: toss 2 lb thawed breast with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp oregano, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, juice of 1 lemon. Bake 425F 20-25 min to 165F. Rest 5 min, slice, ~5 oz into each of 5 containers with rice.
4. Pickled onions: slice 1 red onion into a jar; add 1/2 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt; shake; refrigerate (ready in 1 hr, lasts 2 weeks).
5. Veg: chop cucumbers and tomatoes for Mon-Wed lunches; chop the rest Wed night.
6. Snacks: portion jerky into 5 x 1 oz bags; put bananas + jerky in work bag/desk drawer.
7. Move 1 lb chicken to fridge for Monday's sheet pan if not already thawed.
Midweek: Wed night chop Thu-Fri veg; Fri thaw nothing (steaks fresh).

mocktails.notes: Weeknight swap for whiskey; all <=40 kcal approx. Only 08 and 09 are lemon-forward. No celery.

recipes.name: Smoky Orange Old Fashioned (NA)
ingredients: 6 oz lapsang souchong tea, brewed strong and chilled (1 bag per 6 oz, steep 5 min)
steps: Brew and chill tea.
Express orange peel over a rocks glass and rub the rim.
Add ice, tea, bitters; stir 15 sec; garnish with peel and cinnamon stick.

recipes.name: Grapefruit Rosemary Spritz
steps: Lightly bruise rosemary in glass.
Add ice and grapefruit juice; top with sparkling water.
Garnish with grapefruit wheel and rosemary.

recipes.name: Cucumber Mint Lime Cooler
steps: Muddle mint and 2 cucumber slices gently.
Add ice, lime juice, remaining cucumber.
Top with sparkling water; stir.

recipes.name: Jalapeno Lime Fizz
ingredients: Chili-salt rim (1/4 tsp chili powder + pinch salt)
steps: Rim glass with lime wedge then chili-salt.
Muddle jalapeno lightly with lime juice.
Add ice, top with sparkling water.

recipes.name: Orange Basil Smash
steps: Muddle basil with citrus juices.
Fill glass with crushed ice.
Top with sparkling water; garnish with orange half-wheel.

recipes.name: Black Cherry Smoke (NA Manhattan-style)
ingredients: 4 oz lapsang souchong or smoked black tea, chilled
steps: Stir cherry juice, smoked tea and bitters over ice.
Top with sparkling water.
Express orange peel; garnish.

recipes.name: Hibiscus Ginger Iced Tea
steps: Steep hibiscus tea with ginger 5 min; chill.
Pour over ice with lime juice.
Garnish with lime wheel.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Thyme Sparkler
steps: Bruise thyme in glass.
Add ice and lemon juice; top with sparkling water.
Garnish with lemon wheel and thyme.

recipes.name: Arnold Palmer Fizz
steps: Pour tea and lemon over ice.
Top with sparkling water; stir gently.

recipes.name: Spiced Pomegranate Fizz
steps: Stir pomegranate and lime juice with cinnamon stick in glass 20 sec.
Add ice; top with sparkling water.
Garnish with orange peel.
